newsitem.title: USA: Ex-Fed Gov. Angell sees no rate hike at Feb FOMC.
newsitem.headline: Ex-Fed Gov. Angell sees no rate hike at Feb FOMC.

text.p: Former Federal Reserve Governor Wayne Angell said he expects a heated debate at the upcoming Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting on February 4-5 but does not see an interest rate increase at that time.
Speaking at an Institute of International Bankers luncheon here, Angell said, "The Fed does not make moves after a period when they have been quiet without a donnybrook of a meeting."
